version.changelog:
- Initial release of the yelp skill, providing a pay-per-call Yelp API alternative via fetcher.sh.
- Supports business search by query and location, retrieving details by ID or Yelp URL handle/slug, and fetching business reviews.
- No Yelp Fusion API app approval or daily call caps required; pay with USDC (x402) or prepaid credits.
- All endpoints return clean JSON and cost $0.003 per call.
- Includes full documentation for authentication, endpoints, error handling, and agent setup.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward guide for using a paid Yelp-data API through fetcher.sh, with the payment and credential requirements disclosed.

dimensions.detail: Network access to a third-party paid API and use of a FETCHER_API_KEY are expected for the advertised functionality, but users should treat API keys and paid calls as real account/payment activity.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no executable installer or bundled code; the only setup material is an optional MCP server configuration that points to https://yelp.fetcher.sh/mcp with an optional bearer token.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to API usage examples, authentication options, endpoint descriptions, and error handling; there are no role changes, hidden directives, prompt overrides, or unrelated agent instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request local persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, broad filesystem access, credential harvesting, or modification of system or agent tools.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local business search, details, and reviews, and the artifact only documents matching HTTP GET endpoints plus an optional MCP endpoint for that same service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review fetcher.sh pricing and payment mechanics before use, especially the bearer-key and x402 options, because calls are paid and the skill says refunds are not provided on upstream failures. Install only if you are comfortable sending search queries and business/review requests to this third-party service.
